title: The Westminster Kennel Club Dog Show, the ‘Super Bowl’ of Dog Shows
titleZh: 威斯敏斯特犬舍协会犬展，犬类展览中的"超级碗"
credits: Writers for the Associated Press reported this story from New York. Anna Matteo adapted the reports for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: At America’s 149th Westminster Kennel Club dog show, Monty the giant schnauzer won the top prize.
sentences.zh: 在美国第149届威斯敏斯特犬业协会犬展上，一只名为蒙蒂的巨型雪纳瑞赢得了最高奖项。

sentences.en: The lively schnauzer beat six other finalists in New York City to become the first of his breed to win Westminster’s “best in show.”
sentences.zh: 这只活泼的雪纳瑞在纽约市击败了其他六只进入决赛的犬，成为首只赢得威斯敏斯特犬展"全场总冠军"的该品种犬。

sentences.en: The prize is the most important and respected in the U.S. dog show world.
sentences.zh: 该奖项是美国犬展界最重要、最受尊敬的奖项。

sentences.en: While Monty came close to winning Westminster the past two years, he fell short of the big prize.
sentences.zh: 蒙蒂在过去两年里曾接近赢得威斯敏斯特犬展冠军，但都未能摘得这一大奖。

sentences.en: In December 2024, the dog won another big prize, the huge American Kennel Club championship.
sentences.zh: 2024年12月，这只狗又赢得了另一项大奖——规模庞大的美国犬业协会冠军赛。

sentences.en: But for dog show lovers, Westminster is considered the Super Bowl of all shows.
sentences.zh: 但对犬展爱好者而言，威斯敏斯特犬展被视为所有犬展中的"超级碗"。

sentences.en: This year the comparison is especially fitting.
sentences.zh: 今年这一比喻尤为贴切。

sentences.en: That is because the most respected U.S. dog competition opened on the same weekend as the Super Bowl -- the most important game in American professional football.
sentences.zh: 因为这项最受美国犬展界尊敬的比赛，与超级碗——美国职业橄榄球最重要的一场比赛——恰好在同一个周末举行。

sentences.en: This rare happening came after the dates of both competitions changed in recent years.
sentences.zh: 这一罕见情形出现在两项比赛近年都更改了日期之后。

sentences.en: At Westminster, dogs first compete against other members of their breed.
sentences.zh: 在威斯敏斯特犬展上，犬只首先与同品种的其他犬只进行角逐。

sentences.en: Then, the winner of each breed goes up against other dogs within different competition “groups.”
sentences.zh: 然后，每个品种的冠军将与其他犬只在不同竞赛"组别"中 competition。

sentences.en: Among the groups are sporting, working, toy, and herding.
sentences.zh: 这些组别包括运动犬组、工作犬组、玩具犬组和牧羊犬组。

sentences.en: Group winners then compete in the final round.
sentences.zh: 各组冠军随后在决赛轮中展开角逐。

sentences.en: The best in show winner gets an award – a large, shiny cup called a trophy – and a place in dog-world history.
sentences.zh: "全场总冠军"将获得一份奖品——一个又大又亮的、被称为奖杯的杯子——并载入犬展史册。

sentences.en: The top prize, however, does not include money.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一最高奖项并不包括金钱。

sentences.en: In her report on the dog show, Learning English’s Caty Weaver explains that the Westminster show dates back to 1877.
sentences.zh: 在报道犬展时，"学习英文"栏目的凯蒂·韦弗尔解释说，威斯敏斯特犬展的历史可追溯到1877年。

sentences.en: It centers on the traditional purebred judging that leads to the best in show prize.
sentences.zh: 它以传统的纯种犬评判为中心，由此决出"全场总冠军"奖项。

sentences.en: But over the last few years, the organization has added agility and obedience events open to mixed-breed dogs.
sentences.zh: 但在过去几年里，该组织新增了向混血犬开放的敏捷赛和服从赛项目。

sentences.en: In 2024, Sage, a miniature poodle, won best in show at the 148th Westminster Kennel Club dog show.
sentences.zh: 2024年，一只名为萨吉的迷你贵宾犬赢得了第148届威斯敏斯特犬业协会犬展"全场总冠军"。

sentences.en: And in 2023, a petit basset griffon Vendéen, named Buddy Holly, won best in show at Westminster.
sentences.zh: 而在2023年，一只名为巴迪·霍利的小矮脚猎犬（旺代小短腿格里芬犬）赢得了威斯敏斯特犬展"全场总冠军"。

sentences.en: The breed he represents is known for its rabbit-hunting abilities.
sentences.zh: 他所代表的品种以捕兔能力著称。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo.
sentences.zh: 我是安娜·马泰奥。
